name: aireacondicionadoaq.com

headline.t: The gap: who runs the site.

body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But no Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site.
lesson: Add one Organization block with name, url, logo, and sameAs links. AI answers use it to name you.
summary: aireacondicionadoaq.com scores 90 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 16 are at risk, and 38 pass. Fix first: no Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 11 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 6 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

fix.title: 1 external link leads to an error
fix.evidence: https://search.google.com/local/reviews?placeid=ChIJi3u6cTnVoZURHnT1AC-hAAo answered 404, linked from /. 31 external addresses were checked.
fix.fix: Update each link to the page's new address, link to an archived copy on web.archive.org, or remove it.

fix.title: 1 indexable page is missing from the sitemap
fix.fix: Add them to the sitemap or regenerate it on each deploy.

fix.title: The Google Business Profile links to plain http
fix.evidence: The profile's website link starts with http://, so every visit from Maps begins with a redirect to https.
fix.fix: Use the final https address of the page as the profile's website.

fix.title: Visits from Google Maps are not told apart in analytics
fix.evidence: The profile's website link has no UTM tags, so analytics counts a tap on Website in Maps as an ordinary Google search or a direct visit.
fix.fix: Add utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=business-profile to the profile's website link.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 404 ms
Every page has a meta description
